title: Leaf-outcome tables of the policy language specification
description: The table of the agent profile that the specification's exporter writes and the loader (load.go) reads. This schema checks the shape of the document. The loader also checks what the schema cannot: every kind has a domain; a line names an operator, the kinds it takes, known qualifiers once each, and a grid that fits the domains; every code a line names is in codes; outcomes and value_rule are present exactly when outcome is by_value, and value_rule is sorted; nodes names every algorithm and rule effect; and every combination of operator and operand kinds is answered in every context exactly once, after the loader derives the lines a combination does not carry (negates, aliases) and maps outcomes through leaf. See doc.go.

spec_tag.description: Tag of the specification commit the tables were computed from, such as r65.

negates.description: Each negated operator and the operator it negates. A negated combination without lines takes its positive operator's lines with T and F swapped.

leaf.description: The agent's outcome for each outcome of legacy the agent lacks; the loader maps every result through it.

codes.description: The legend of the grids: each code, one ASCII letter or digit, and the result it stands for, in legacy's outcomes.

cells.description: Each line holds the operator (#/$defs/operator), the left kind and, unless the operator is unary (#/$defs/unaryOperator), the right kind (#/$defs/kind); then the qualifiers place= (#/$defs/place), effect= (#/$defs/effect), disjunction= and in_iterate= (true or false), each at most once, which narrow the contexts the line covers; then the grid, one row of codes per point of the left kind's domain and one code per point of the right kind's, the points in domain order with VALUE once per class. A single row stands for every row, and a single code for a whole row.

class.description: s a string; n a number or a boolean; l a list of scalars; hl a list of scalars from a HEADER or GENERAL PIP; xn a list with a null element; xl a list with a list or an object element and no null element; xo an object; z a null value in state VALUE.

permit.description: Some applicable child permits and none denies.

deny.description: Some applicable child denies and none permits.

both.description: Some child permits and some denies.

nodes.description: How the profile combines the outcomes of the nodes above the leaves.

absent_algorithm.description: The algorithm of a node that names none.

effects.description: The outcome of a rule whose effect is neither ALLOW nor DENY; other covers every effect not listed. Every rule effect is required.

absent_effect.description: What a rule without an effect counts as.

absent_expression.description: The value of an absent target or condition.

knobs.description: Specification settings keyed by their name in the specification, with the agent profile's values.

classes.description: Required and non-empty exactly when states lists VALUE.

aliases.description: Kinds that answer as an earlier kind of the same domain, their representative. A combination over an alias without lines takes its representative's lines, renamed.

outcomes.description: Present exactly when outcome is by_value.

value_rule.description: Present exactly when outcome is by_value: the value rules the specification went through over all representative values, sorted. A negated operator names the rule of the operator it negates.
